note: Bootstrap lock created before remediation implementation. Future locks are generated/verified by tools/change-plan-lock.cjs.

plan.change: Remediate adversarial audit Phase A+B: immutable Plan identity and risk gate
expectedChanges: Bind verification to an immutable Plan digest and revision identity
Require repository identity, READY state, authority and Full-plan design fields
Classify high-risk runtime/config/OS paths so they cannot be treated as Lite CONTENT
Prevent exclusion of core impacts and prevent all-impact exclusion from self-verifying
Add PR gate workflow and adversarial regression coverage without changing town runtime or production
hqDecisions: Use the adversarial audit F01/F02/F03/F05/F06/F13 as the remediation scope
Keep Lite staging changes lightweight; harden high-risk and promotion paths first
Do not add a permanent plan database or automate Owner taste decisions
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: No town/runtime UI or asset behavior changes; verification is mechanical and will be followed by independent adversarial re-audit.
plan.rollback: Revert the remediation branch/PR; production is untouched.
outOfScope: Mechanical evidence provenance implementation beyond minimal trusted gate
Semantic diff templates and stale-write protection F10/F11
unverified: Repository required-check/ruleset enforcement cannot be assumed until GitHub repository settings are confirmed.
plan.problem: The v0.1 Change OS can be bypassed or self-rewritten: a Plan can be replaced after implementation, high-risk paths can be under-classified, unknown runtime paths can pass with no impact, and all impacts can be excluded.
plan.currentContract: Change Plan, Scope Guard, Impact Check and Verification Record exist, but their use is soft-enforced and Plan/evidence trust boundaries are incomplete.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The adversarial audit reproduced post-hoc base/check rewrites, CONTENT/Lite misclassification of shared runtime, unknown runtime with zero required impacts, and all-impact exclusion reaching VERIFIED.
plan.design: Introduce v0.2 Plan identity/digest/revision validation and a risk policy derived from changed paths. Require Full/HQ for shared/runtime/OS risk, keep domain-specific Lite/Standard paths lightweight, and add a PR gate suitable for required-check enforcement.
alternativesRejected: Store every Plan forever in a database
Use free-form evidence strings as the only trust mechanism
plan.migration: Existing v0.1 historical records remain readable as legacy but cannot satisfy the new trusted high-risk gate.
plan.compatibility: Town runtime and production release behavior remain unchanged. The remediation affects Change OS tooling and documentation only.
boundaryCases: new root JS/HTML/CSS with no explicit Impact Rule
Full Plan with missing HQ/design fields or empty checks
testPlan: Add adversarial tests for false class, unknown high-risk path, all exclusions, plan digest mismatch and repository mismatch
Run Change Operations CI on the remediation branch
plan.promotionRisk: No production promotion in this phase. Staging merge remains subject to review; required-check repository settings are separately verified.
